disclosure: Authored synthetic demonstration code; no customer data or external source code.

cases.title: Permit discounts from partner feeds
cases.spec: Discount rates must be between 0 and 1 inclusive. Reject any rate outside this interval before charging an order.
cases.change: Relax rate validation to accept partner feed discounts.

expected_issue.description: A rate above one passes validation and makes the order total negative.

cases.reproduction: total_after_discount(100, 1.2) returns -20.00 instead of raising ValueError.

cases.title: Normalize receipt amounts for notification templates
cases.spec: Order totals are dollar Decimal values. Receipt messages must show the same dollar amount charged by place_order.
cases.change: Convert receipt totals in the notification formatter.

expected_issue.description: orders.place_order supplies dollars; receipt_message divides them by 100 and tells customers an amount 100 times too small.

cases.reproduction: place_order(..., subtotal=20) charges 20.00 but the receipt says $0.20.

cases.title: Handle expedited high-value payouts
cases.spec: An expedited payout must deduct exactly the requested amount. The daily cap applies equally to standard and expedited payouts; no additional fee is charged.
cases.change: Add a special path for expedited payouts above 500.

expected_issue.description: The newly added high-value expedited path deducts an unauthorized 25 fee and is not exercised by the authored suite.

cases.title: Persist an order before sending its receipt
cases.spec: If receipt publication fails, order creation must leave no persisted order. If refund publication fails, the order must remain paid.
cases.change: Write order state before appending notification messages.

expected_issue.description: The order or refund state is changed before notification append; a publication error leaves partially committed state.

cases.reproduction: Pass a notifications list whose append raises; place_order leaves an order in orders despite raising.

cases.title: Simplify order lookup by ID
cases.spec: Order lookup must enforce the caller's tenant_id, even when the order ID is valid.
cases.change: Use order ID as the sole lookup key.

expected_issue.description: Removing the tenant predicate lets one tenant read another tenant's order by ID.

cases.title: Reduce time spent under the capture lock
cases.spec: A payment idempotency key must produce one capture record under concurrent calls. The existence check and insert are one atomic operation.
cases.change: Move the existence check outside the lock.

expected_issue.description: Two callers can both see a missing key before either acquires the lock, then each creates a receipt and overwrites the map entry.

cases.reproduction: Pause two callers after the unlocked key check; both pass, then each enters the lock and constructs a different receipt.
